title: propose_document_changes arguments
description: Arguments of the agent-service tool `propose_document_changes`. Propose section-level changes to the current item's Markdown document. The user reviews them per section (accept / edit / reject) and only accepted sections are applied. Return ONLY the sections you change. Never remove or rewrite content the user wrote or confirmed ('- [x]' items); prefer mode append for lists. On approval the tool returns a result matching document-changes.result. All argument keys are required in the user's `editedArgs` (full replacement).

summary.description: Short summary of the proposed changes for the reviewer.

baseVersion.description: The item version the proposal is based on (from get_item_context). Sections changed by someone else since then are reported as conflicts.

id.description: Identifier of this section change, unique within the proposal (for example "s1"). Used for accept/edit/reject and in the result.

heading.description: Existing or new level-2 (##) heading of the item's Markdown document, without the leading ##. Matching ignores case and whitespace.

mode.description: replace swaps the section body (confirmed '- [x]' lines are always kept); append adds new lines to the end without duplicating existing ones.

markdown.description: Section body in Markdown, without the heading line.

rationale.description: Optional short reason for the change, shown to the reviewer.

sections.description: Only the sections you change; untouched sections are kept.
